title: What Transfers Across Protein Pockets? Experience Reuse in Molecular Optimization for Agentic Structure-Based Drug Design
title_zh: 什么能在蛋白质口袋之间迁移？智能体式基于结构的药物设计中分子优化的经验复用

paragraphs.en: AI for Drug Discovery: Bridging the Translation Gap (NeurIPS 2026)
paragraphs.zh: AI 药物发现：弥合转化鸿沟 (NeurIPS 2026)

paragraphs.en: LLM agents optimize a ligand in a protein pocket by editing it step by step and docking each edit. Recent agents first spend extra dockings probing the complex with controlled edits; guidance induced from these probes is reported to help more than the chemical knowledge the model already carries. The probes are then discarded with the instance that produced them, so the obvious next step is to keep them in an experience base, letting a new pocket inherit what earlier ones already paid for. Such a base is read through a key : the record properties under which past edits are pooled and a new one is looked up. Using the full log of one such run over the CrossDocked2020 test-set pockets, we ask whether its keys recur on a pocket the base has never seen and still separate improving from worsening edits. Using the contacts at the site being edited, the action, and the round as a key, the base separates them sharply. Within our analysis, this separation is largely explained by how much the edit changed the molecule’s size, the action, and the round, none of which describes the target. That is not because the target is irrelevant: naming it outright separates them several times more sharply. For a pocket absent from the base, transfer must rely on a description rather than its identity. Among the exact-match descriptions we evaluate, the more specific ones rarely recur, whereas the coarser ones provide little separation; the signals that do transfer primarily describe the edit and the molecule it produced rather than the target. Under the representations and lookup scheme studied here, an experience base may be more useful for prioritizing an agent’s own proposals for docking than for directly prescribing what to build.

paragraphs.en: LLM agents that iteratively refine a ligand inside a protein pocket are a promising new approach for ligand optimization in structure-based drug design (SBDD) [ 1 , 5 , 17 ] . The most recent of these, PROBE, adds a probing stage that measures how a particular pocket-ligand complex responds to controlled edits, and reports that guidance induced from those measured responses is better than prior chemical knowledge inside the agent [ 17 ] . But measuring edit responses in the pocket requires extra dockings on top of those the optimization itself needs, and the per-instance edit manual it produces is never carried beyond that instance. In contrast, agents outside chemistry write what a run learns into an experience base and retrieve it on later tasks [ 13 , 15 , 16 , 7 , 9 ] . Thus, a promising direction is to accumulate the edit responses, so that a new optimization could start from evidence earlier runs already bought.
paragraphs.zh: 在蛋白质口袋中迭代优化配体的LLM智能体是基于结构的药物设计（SBDD）中一种颇有前景的配体优化新方法 [ 1 , 5 , 17 ] 。 其中最新的是PROBE，它增加了一个探测阶段，用于测量特定口袋-配体复合物对受控编辑的响应，并报告称由这些测得的响应诱导出的引导优于智能体内部的既有化学知识 [ 17 ] 。 但是，在口袋中测量编辑响应需要在优化本身所需的对接之外进行额外的对接，而且它生成的针对每个实例的编辑手册从未被应用到该实例之外。 相比之下，化学领域之外的智能体会将一次运行中学到的内容写入经验库，并在后续任务中检索它 [ 13 , 15 , 16 , 7 , 9 ] 。 因此，一个有前景的方向是积累这些编辑响应，使新的优化能够从先前运行已经付出代价获得的证据出发。

paragraphs.en: That direction depends on how reliably measurements from one pocket remain informative on another. We test it on an experience base formed by a complete run log of one full PROBE run over the CrossDocked2020 test-set pockets (Section 3 ). Such a base is read through a key : a tuple of record properties under which past records are pooled and a candidate edit is looked up. A useful key should have three things hold at once: (i) it should utilize information from both the pocket and the ligand, (ii) it recurs on a pocket the base has never seen, and (iii) it still separates what an edit does there.
paragraphs.zh: 这一方向取决于来自一个口袋的测量结果在多大程度上仍能对另一个口袋保持信息有效性。 我们在一个经验库上测试它，该经验库由一次完整 PROBE 运行在 CrossDocked2020 测试集口袋上的完整运行日志构成（第 3 节）。 这样的经验库通过一个键来读取：键是一个记录属性元组，过去的记录在该元组下被归并，候选编辑也通过它被查找。 一个有用的键应同时满足三点：(i) 它应利用来自口袋和配体双方的信息，(ii) 它在经验库从未见过的口袋上会重复出现，(iii) 它仍能区分一次编辑在那里所产生的作用。

paragraphs.en: The records already supply a key that appears to meet all three: the contacts at the edited atom, the action, and the round. It recurs on almost every edit and separates improving from worsening ones sharply, but for the two Replace actions, the gap becomes indistinguishable from zero after matching the action, heavy-atom change, and round. As the only description of pockets in this key, the contact features add little detectable separation after the edit properties are held equal. Naming the pocket separates outcomes several times more sharply than that key does, but a pocket the base has never seen must be represented through transferable descriptors rather than identity. Among the discretized, exact-match descriptions we evaluate, those that separate outcomes recur on few held-out pockets, whereas those that recur broadly add little separation. Thus, none of the evaluated keys meets all three requirements at once. The keys that transfer most consistently describe properties of the edit or its product more than properties of the pocket. We discuss candidate prioritization as a possible use of this base.
paragraphs.zh: 这些记录已经提供了一个似乎满足全部三项的键：被编辑原子上的接触、动作以及轮次。 它在几乎每次编辑中都会出现，并能鲜明地区分改进与恶化的情况，但对于两个 Replace 动作，在匹配动作、重原子变化和轮次之后，其差距变得与零无异。 作为该键中对口袋的唯一描述，在编辑属性被保持相等之后，接触特征几乎没有带来可检测的区分度。 对口袋命名比该键更能鲜明地区分结果许多倍，但基座从未见过的口袋必须通过可迁移的描述符而非身份来表示。 在我们评估的离散化、精确匹配的描述中，能区分结果的那几个在少量留出口袋上出现，而广泛出现的那几个几乎没有带来区分度。 因此，所评估的键中没有哪一个能同时满足全部三项要求。 迁移性最好的键更多地描述编辑或其产物的属性，而非口袋的属性。 我们将候选优先级排序作为该基座的一种可能用途加以讨论。

paragraphs.en: Recent pipelines differ in what they ask the LLM to do, but all keep the measured experience within the current instance. CIDD [ 5 ] has several LLM roles that propose edited molecules directly. LIDDIA [ 1 ] uses the LLM as a planner and hands the edit to an algorithmic executor. PROBE [ 17 ] spends extra dockings per instance on the LLM proposed controlled edits, measuring how the pocket responds, and turning those responses into per-instance optimization guidance. In all three cases, information learned about the pocket remains within the current optimization instance rather than being reused on a new pocket.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的流水线在要求大语言模型做什么方面各不相同，但都将被测量的经验保持在当前实例之内。 CIDD [ 5 ] 拥有多个大语言模型角色，直接提出经过编辑的分子。 LIDDIA [ 1 ] 将大语言模型用作规划器，并把编辑交给算法执行器。 PROBE [ 17 ] 在每个实例上花费额外的对接，针对大语言模型提出的受控编辑，测量口袋如何响应，并将这些响应转化为逐实例的优化指导。 在这三种情况下，关于口袋学到的信息都保留在当前的优化实例内，而不会在新的口袋上复用。

These systems also face questions of transfer. In SBDD, we examine a specific form of transfer: whether edit outcomes measured on one protein pocket remain informative on another.

sents.en: An agent for molecular optimization in SBDD is given a protein pocket and a ligand, and edits the ligand step-by-step so that the molecule binds the pocket more tightly and has better druggability.
sents.zh: 用于 SBDD（基于结构的药物设计）中分子优化的智能体接受一个蛋白口袋和一个配体作为输入，并对配体逐步进行编辑，使分子更紧密地结合口袋并具有更好的成药性。

sents.en: Following [ 17 ] , we score a molecule m m by affinity A ⁡ ( m ) = − Vina ⁡ ( m ) A(m)=-\mathrm{Vina}(m) [ 14 ] and calculate N m N_{m} as the number of heavy atoms.
sents.zh: 沿用 [ 17 ]，我们用亲和力 A ⁡ ( m ) = − Vina ⁡ ( m ) A(m)=-\mathrm{Vina}(m) [ 14 ] 对分子 m m 打分，并计算 N m N_{m} 作为重原子数目。

sents.en: We define Δ ​ A = A ⁡ ( m ′ ) − A ⁡ ( m ) \Delta A=A(m^{\prime})-A(m) , where m ′ m^{\prime} is the optimized molecule after one optimization step, and Δ ​ N = N m ′ − N m \Delta N=N_{m^{\prime}}-N_{m} is the change in heavy-atom count.
sents.zh: 我们定义 Δ ​ A = A ⁡ ( m ′ ) − A ⁡ ( m ) \Delta A=A(m^{\prime})-A(m)，其中 m ′ m^{\prime} 是经过一步优化后的优化分子，Δ ​ N = N m ′ − N m \Delta N=N_{m^{\prime}}-N_{m} 是重原子数目的变化。

paragraphs.en: Our experience base comes from a single full run of the PROBE workflow (Appendix A ) on the CrossDocked2020 test-set pockets [ 4 ] . For each pocket, PROBE optimized 10 initial ligand molecules generated by MolCRAFT [ 11 ] , proceeding through a probe phase (labeled round 0) followed by five rounds of design-make-test-analyze (labeled rounds 1–5). We recorded each successfully built-and-docked edit by the agent as a record in the experience base, ultimately generating 14,341 records, including 5,398 from the probe phase and 8,943 from DMTA edits. Each record in the experience base includes the following properties: (i) pocket, (ii) ligand, (iii) round, (iv) editing action, (v) four categorical constraints on the fragment to introduce, (vi) pocket-ligand contact features, and (vii) the outcome Δ ​ A , Δ ​ N \Delta A,\Delta N . Appendix B details each property.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的经验库来自在 CrossDocked2020 测试集口袋 [4] 上对 PROBE 工作流（附录 A）的一次完整运行。 对于每个口袋，PROBE 对由 MolCRAFT [11] 生成的 10 个初始配体分子进行优化，先经过探针阶段（标记为第 0 轮），随后进行五轮设计-制造-测试-分析（标记为第 1–5 轮）。 我们将智能体每次成功构建并对接的编辑作为一条记录存入经验库，最终生成了 14,341 条记录，其中 5,398 条来自探针阶段，8,943 条来自 DMTA 编辑。 经验库中的每条记录包含以下属性：(i) 口袋，(ii) 配体，(iii) 轮次，(iv) 编辑动作，(v) 关于待引入片段的四项类别约束，(vi) 口袋-配体接触特征，以及 (vii) 结果 Δ ​ A, Δ ​ N \Delta A,\Delta N。 附录 B 详细说明了每个属性。

paragraphs.en: We use the experience base to predict whether a candidate edit will improve affinity. A key κ \kappa , a tuple of record properties, selects the subset of records that agree with it on those properties. Writing n κ + n^{+}_{\kappa} and n κ − n^{-}_{\kappa} for the number of records in that subset with Δ ​ A > 0 \Delta A>0 and with Δ ​ A < 0 \Delta A<0 , the base predicts improve when n κ + ≥ n κ − n^{+}_{\kappa}\geq n^{-}_{\kappa} and worsen otherwise. Every held-out evaluation below splits at the pocket, not at the record: for each pocket in turn, the base is built from the records of the other pockets and used to label the held-out pocket’s records, so every record is labelled by a base that never saw its pocket.

paragraphs.en: The results favor proposal ranking over direct edit prescription. The keys that retain separation on a new pocket contain little pocket information, and inside one pocket they may not need it for ranking. The base could rank those candidates by how its own records with the same key value turned out, allowing the agent to prioritize which ones to dock. Every key value it reads is fixed before that docking is paid for: the fragment constraints when the agent writes the edit, the ligand keys once the candidate is built (Appendix B ). Directly prescribing what to build would require a transferable representation that conditions effectively on a previously unseen pocket; we do not identify such a key among the representations evaluated in Section 4.2 . Candidate ranking, closed-loop optimization gains, and docking savings have not been evaluated here.

paragraphs.en: Limitations. (i) The evidence comes from one agent pipeline (PROBE) run once per instance, one generator of initial ligands (MolCRAFT), one scoring function (AutoDock Vina), the CrossDocked2020 test pockets, one set of six structural pocket descriptors, and one family of keys: categorical, exact-match lookups over discretised record properties. A different description of the pocket, or a key that pools by similarity rather than exact match, is untested; our conclusions therefore apply to the representations and lookup family evaluated here rather than to cross-pocket experience reuse in general. In particular, combining pocket descriptors with the strongest ligand-change keys remains untested. (ii) The corpus is assembly- and policy-selected: only edits that built and docked become records, and every edit was proposed under the agent’s own site map and EditManual, which already rules out the edits it judges harmful. Those are also the edits such an agent would be looking up at run time, so the corpus matches the setting the base is meant for; an agent that proposes edits without a pocket-fitted manual is untested. Differences in retained record counts, action distributions, and chemical diversity across pockets are not separately characterized. (iii) The endpoint is a Vina score, not experimental binding. Intervals are unadjusted for multiple key comparisons, so marginal differences are exploratory.

paragraphs.en: PROBE [ 17 ] optimizes one pocket-ligand complex at a time. The input ligand comes from a 3D generative model and is docked into the pocket. paragraphs.en: PROBE decomposes the input ligand with BRICS [ 3 ] . For each fragment it collects three streams of signal: which protein contacts the fragment makes, from PLIP [ 12 ] ; how the fragment fits the pocket geometrically; and property signals covering ligand efficiency and known problematic groups. A diagnosis LLM reads these, writes a short profile of the complex, and picks three or four fragments as editable sites . It labels each site synergy (one edit can plausibly improve both objectives), tension (improving one is likely to hurt the other), or liability (a structural liability to repair whatever the trade-off). Those labelled sites are the site map . It is built once, from the input complex, and never changes.
paragraphs.zh: PROBE 使用 BRICS [ 3 ] 对输入配体进行分解。 对于每个片段，它收集三路信号：该片段与蛋白质发生哪些接触，来自 PLIP [ 12 ]；该片段在几何上如何适配口袋；以及涵盖配体效率和已知问题基团的性质信号。 一个诊断 LLM 阅读这些信息，撰写该复合物的简短概况，并挑选三到四个片段作为可编辑位点。 它为每个位点标注为协同（一处编辑有望同时改善两个目标）、冲突（改善一个目标很可能损害另一个）或缺陷（无论权衡如何都需要修复的结构缺陷）。 这些被标注的位点即构成位点图谱。 它基于输入复合物仅构建一次，之后不再改变。

paragraphs.en: A planner LLM proposes three strategies — affinity-first, druggability-first, co-optimization — each naming target sites and an edit prescription. A generator LLM turns each strategy into four structured edits: three that apply it at high, medium and low magnitude, and one counterfactual that reverses it as a control. That is twelve probe edits per input ligand. All twelve are submitted for assembly, docking, and scoring; only successfully built-and-docked edits enter our corpus. This probe stage is the whole of what we label round 0 0 .
paragraphs.zh: 一个规划器 LLM 提出三种策略——亲和力优先、成药性优先、协同优化——每种策略都指明目标位点及一套编辑处方。 一个生成器 LLM 将每种策略转化为四个结构化编辑：其中三个分别以高、中、低幅度应用该策略，另一个作为对照的反事实编辑则逆转该策略。 也就是说，每个输入配体共有十二个探针编辑。 这十二个编辑全部提交进行组装、对接和打分；只有成功构建并完成对接的编辑才进入我们的语料库。 这个探针阶段就是我们标记为第 0 轮 0 的全部内容。

paragraphs.en: An analyzer summarizes the available probe outcomes. For each strategy it reports whether the high–medium–low response is monotone improvement, an activity cliff, saturation, or flat and negative, and whether reversing the strategy makes the scores worse, better or unchanged; a strategy is credible only if the forward probes improve and the counterfactual does not. A manual-construction LLM then writes the EditManual . For each site it records a pharmacophore role, the actions allowed and forbidden there together with the size, polarity, flexibility and shape any later fragment must satisfy, and a blacklist of structural features. It also records which sites may be edited independently and which edit directions are mutually exclusive.
paragraphs.zh: 分析器会总结可用的探测结果。 对于每种策略，它报告高—中—低的响应是属于单调提升、活性悬崖、饱和还是平坦且负面，以及反转该策略会使分数变差、变好还是不变；只有当正向探测有所提升且反事实并未提升时，该策略才是可信的。 然后由一个手动构建的 LLM 撰写 EditManual 。 对于每个位点，它记录药效团角色、该位点允许和禁止的操作，以及后续任何片段必须满足的尺寸、极性、柔性和形状要求，还有一份结构特征黑名单。 它还记录哪些位点可以独立编辑，以及哪些编辑方向是互斥的。

paragraphs.en: Five DMTA rounds follow, rounds 1 1 – 5 5 in our labelling. In each round an affinity agent and a druggability agent each draft one localized edit under the site map, the EditManual and the edit history. The two drafts are cross-reviewed against the manual, and a co-optimization agent reconciles them into a third. All three are built, docked and labelled against the intent that produced them. The edit history is extended, and any EditManual entry an outcome contradicts is tightened.

sents.en: The other three actions need a fragment, which the engine draws from a library of 8,505 8{,}505 BRICS fragments [ 3 ] of ChEMBL Phase-I compounds.

sents.en: Each library fragment carries a precomputed QED, synthetic accessibility, chiral-centre count, rotatable-bond count, molecular weight and discrete shape category, so the constraints become a database query.

Its product m ′ m^{\prime} is the molecule the engine returned. Fields (i)–(vi) are fixed by the time the agent writes the edit, before the product exists. Of the outcomes in (vii), only Δ ​ A \Delta A needs the docking; the ligand counts can be read as soon as the engine returns the product.

paragraphs.en: One of four actions. Delete_Group removes the fragment rooted at the edit atom and caps the open valence. Grow attaches a library fragment at the edit atom. Replace_Terminal_Group and Replace_Sidechain_or_Ring swap a library fragment for the terminal group, or for the sidechain or ring system, rooted there. We record the edit atom index but never key on it, because an index means nothing in another molecule.
paragraphs.zh: 四种操作之一。 Delete_Group 删除以编辑原子为根的片段并封闭开放价键。 Grow 在编辑原子处连接一个库片段。 Replace_Terminal_Group 和 Replace_Sidechain_or_Ring 将库片段替换为该处的末端基团，或替换为侧链或环系。 我们记录编辑原子的索引但绝不以其为键，因为索引在另一个分子中毫无意义。

paragraphs.en: A Delete_Group record introduces no fragment and carries no constraint values, so row 11 of Table 2 is scored on the other three actions. The engine has a fifth field, formal charge, that the agent never set; we do not record it. Within a constraint cell the engine returns a fixed fragment (Appendix A ), so which molecule gets built is decided by these four fields and the edit atom, not by the agent’s choice of fragment.
paragraphs.zh: Delete_Group 记录不引入片段，也不携带约束值，因此表 2 的第 11 行按其他三个操作进行评分。 该引擎有第五个字段，即形式电荷，智能体从未设置过它；我们不记录该字段。 在一个约束单元格内，引擎返回固定的片段（附录 A），因此构建出哪个分子由这四个字段和编辑原子决定，而不是由智能体对片段的选择决定。

paragraphs.en: PLIP [ 12 ] annotates every ligand heavy atom of the docked parent complex with the protein contacts it forms. We join the contact types at the edit atom, in a fixed order, into one categorical label, and write NONE where the atom forms no detected contact. The label drops residue identity, the number of contacts of each type, and all distances and angles. NONE covers 61 % 61\% of the records; hbond and hydrophobic follow, and no other value reaches 5 % 5\% .
paragraphs.zh: PLIP [ 12 ] 为对接后的母复合物中的每个配体重原子标注其所形成的蛋白质接触。 我们在编辑原子上将各接触类型按固定顺序连接为一个分类标签，对于未检测到任何接触的原子则写入 NONE。 该标签舍弃了残基身份、各类型的接触数量以及所有距离和角度。 NONE 占记录的 61 % 61\%；其次是 hbond 和 hydrophobic，没有其他值达到 5 % 5\% 。

paragraphs.en: Six descriptors describe a pocket. Each is computed from the receptor structure and the reference ligand shipped with the CrossDocked2020 test split [ 4 ] , and from nothing the run produces, so a key can read them on a pocket the base has never seen. The residue set is every residue with a heavy atom within 10 10 Å of a reference-ligand heavy atom. Five descriptors summarize it: its residue count, and its fraction of residues in each of four classes.
paragraphs.zh: 六个描述符用来描述一个口袋。 每个描述符都由受体结构和 CrossDocked2020 测试集 [ 4 ] 随附的参考配体计算得出，而不使用运行产生的任何内容，因此密钥可以在基座从未见过的口袋上读取它们。 残基集合是每个在参考配体重原子 10 10 Å 范围内含有重原子的残基。 五个描述符对其进行了总结：残基数量，以及四个类别中每一类残基所占的比例。
